title: Existing existential ind-etale refinement of a weakly etale map
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings in a common universe and let $f:R\to S$ be weakly etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. There exist a commutative ring $T$ in the same universe and a ring homomorphism $g:S\to T$ such that $g$ is ind-etale and faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] and $g\circ f$ is ind-etale.

proof.text: The specified refinement theorem gives the ring T and its structural map g, with g faithfully flat and ind-etale and composite ind-etale. Forget the specification of the construction and package T, its commutative ring structure, g, and those three properties. The existential result is already proved separately as RingHom.WeaklyEtale.exists_indEtale_comp; the source proof algebraizes f, applies Algebra.WeaklyEtale.exists_indEtale, and rewrites the algebra maps. Its axioms were checked to be only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.

lean.statement: theorem RingHom.WeaklyEtale.exists_indEtale_comp {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {f : R →+* S} (hf : f.WeaklyEtale) : ∃ (T : Type u) (_ : CommRing T) (g : S →+* T), g.IndEtale ∧ g.FaithfullyFlat ∧ (g.comp f).IndEtale
lean.note: Existing source theorem, reused without modification. Single-file #print axioms checks show only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The existential result suffices; the particular refinement construction is not needed.
